cohort: 1004 infants (496 girls, 508 boys) under six months of age from 27 pediatric primary healthcare units in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
finding: Four distinct groups of infants with different risk profiles for growth were identified, though no differences in postnatal weight adequacy were found between the groups.
mod_finding: One identified group (n=139) consisted of infants born exclusively by cesarean delivery to multiparous mothers, with a high prevalence of prematurity and low birthweight, but also a high prevalence of exclusive breastfeeding and low hospitalization rate.
